summary: Stop recursive Git and GitHub recorder wrapper invocations

schema.detail: No database layout or schema-version change.

compatibility.detail: Recorder wrapper reentry for the same program fails immediately with exit 126 instead of starting another child. Delegated tools receive a PATH without recorders so ordinary nested Git calls continue to use real tools. Git and GitHub depth flags are independent. Executable-identity checks exclude recorder symlinks and hard links. Nested git/gh calls from hooks, aliases, and extensions are not recorded; a nested gh pr create or gh issue create produces no recorder receipt. The rejected second recorder invocation creates no additional record or child.

downtime.detail: No service interruption is required by the source change.

manual.detail: No additional installed-user configuration is required.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change.
